payload.artist_html: G. F. Funston, T. W. Dudgeon, D. J. Simon, D. M. Dufault, C. Boyd, D. Fowler, P. J. Currie & D. C. Evans
payload.credit_html: Supplementary Materials for: "Fruit-eating adaptations in a Late Cretaceous oviraptorosaur (Theropoda)"
payload.description_html: Pterygoid (ROM VP 88690; paratype) of Infernogallus jamesi. a–b, Right pterygoid of ROM VP 88690 in lateral (a) and medial (b) views. c–d, photographs of muscular attachment areas for pterygoideus ventralis (c) in dorsolateral view and pterygoideus dorsalis (d) in ventromedial view, showing textural changes marking edges of muscular attachment (arrows). e–f, photogrammetric models of right pterygoid showing reconstructed muscular attachment areas, in dorsolateral (e) and ventromedial (f) views; note that these views do not exactly correspond to the perspectives in (c) and (d). Scale increments in (c) and (d) are millimeters, scale bar for (a) and (b) are as indicated.
